questions.question: Avro schemas are defined with _____
questions.explanation: JSON implementation facilitates implementation in languages that already have JSON libraries.

questions.question: Point out the correct statement.

options.A: Avro provides functionality similar to systems such as Thrift
options.B: When Avro is used in RPC, the client and server exchange data in the connection handshake
options.C: Apache Avro, Avro, Apache, and the Avro and Apache logos are trademarks of The Java Foundation

questions.explanation: Avro differs from these systems in the fundamental aspects like untagged data.

questions.question: __________ facilitates construction of generic data-processing systems and languages.
questions.explanation: Avro does not require that code be generated.

questions.question: With ______ we can store data and read it easily with various programming languages.
questions.explanation: Avro is optimized to minimize the disk space needed by our data and it is flexible.

questions.question: Point out the wrong statement.

options.A: Apache Avro™ is a data serialization system
options.B: Avro provides simple integration with dynamic languages

questions.explanation: Code generation is not required to read or write data files nor to use or implement RPC protocols in Avro.

questions.question: ________ are a way of encoding structured data in an efficient yet extensible format.
questions.explanation: Google uses Protocol Buffers for almost all of its internal RPC protocols and file formats.

questions.question: Thrift resolves possible conflicts through _________ of the field.
questions.explanation: Avro resolves possible conflicts through the name of the field.

questions.question: Avro is said to be the future _______ layer of Hadoop.
questions.explanation: When Avro is used in RPC, the client and server exchange schemas in the connection handshake.

questions.question: When using reflection to automatically build our schemas without code generation, we need to configure Avro using?
questions.explanation: For strongly typed languages like Java, it also provides a generation code layer, including RPC services code generation.

questions.question: We can declare the schema of our data either in a ______ file.
questions.explanation: Schema can be declared using an IDL or simply through Java beans by using reflection-based schema building.

questions.question: The Mapper implementation processes one line at a time via _________ method.
questions.explanation: The Mapper outputs are sorted and then partitioned per Reducer.

questions.question: Point out the correct statement.

options.A: Mapper maps input key/value pairs to a set of intermediate key/value pairs
options.B: Applications typically implement the Mapper and Reducer interfaces to provide the map and reduce methods
options.C: Mapper and Reducer interfaces form the core of the job

questions.explanation: The transformed intermediate records do not need to be of the same type as the input records.

questions.question: The Hadoop MapReduce framework spawns one map task for each __________ generated by the InputFormat for the job.
questions.explanation: Mapper implementations are passed the JobConf for the job via the JobConfigurable.configure(JobConf) method and override it to initialize themselves.

questions.question: Users can control which keys (and hence records) go to which Reducer by implementing a custom?
questions.explanation: Users can control the grouping by specifying a Comparator via JobConf.setOutputKeyComparatorClass(Class).

questions.question: Point out the wrong statement.

options.A: The Mapper outputs are sorted and then partitioned per Reducer
options.B: The total number of partitions is the same as the number of reduce tasks for the job
options.C: The intermediate, sorted outputs are always stored in a simple (key-len, key, value-len, value) format

questions.explanation: All intermediate values associated with a given output key are subsequently grouped by the framework, and passed to the Reducer(s) to determine the final output.

questions.question: Applications can use the ____________ to report progress and set application-level status messages.
questions.explanation: Reporter is also used to update Counters, or just indicate that they are alive.

questions.question: The right level of parallelism for maps seems to be around _________ maps per-node.
questions.explanation: Task setup takes a while, so it is best if the maps take at least a minute to execute.

questions.question: The number of reduces for the job is set by the user via _________
questions.explanation: Reducer has 3 primary phases: shuffle, sort and reduce.

questions.question: The framework groups Reducer inputs by key in _________ stage.
questions.explanation: The shuffle and sort phases occur simultaneously; while map-outputs are being fetched they are merged.

questions.question: The output of the reduce task is typically written to the FileSystem via _____________
questions.explanation: The output of the Reducer is not sorted.

questions.question: Yarn commands are invoked by the ________ script.
questions.explanation: Running the yarn script without any arguments prints the description for all commands.

questions.question: Point out the correct statement.

options.A: Each queue has strict ACLs which controls which users can submit applications to individual queues
options.B: Hierarchy of queues is supported to ensure resources are shared among the sub-queues of an organization
options.C: Queues are allocated a fraction of the capacity of the grid in the sense that a certain capacity of resources will be at their disposal

questions.explanation: All applications submitted to a queue will have access to the capacity allocated to the queue.

questions.question: The queue definitions and properties such as ________ ACLs can be changed, at runtime.
questions.explanation: Administrators can add additional queues at runtime, but queues cannot be deleted at runtime.

questions.question: The CapacityScheduler has a predefined queue called _________
questions.explanation: All queues in the system are children of the root queue.

questions.question: Point out the wrong statement.

options.A: The multiple of the queue capacity which can be configured to allow a single user to acquire more resources
options.B: Changing queue properties and adding new queues is very simple
options.C: Queues cannot be deleted, only addition of new queues is supported

questions.explanation: You need to edit conf/capacity-scheduler.xml and run yarn rmadmin -refreshQueues for changing queue properties.

questions.question: The updated queue configuration should be a valid one i.e. queue-capacity at each level should be equal to _________
questions.explanation: Queues cannot be deleted, only the addition of new queues is supported.

questions.question: Users can bundle their Yarn code in a _________ file and execute it using jar command.
questions.explanation: Usage: yarn jar <jar> [mainClass] args…

questions.question: Which of the following command is used to dump the log container?
questions.explanation: Usage: yarn logs -applicationId <application ID> <options>.

questions.question: __________ will clear the RMStateStore and is useful if past applications are no longer needed.
questions.explanation: -format-state-store formats the RMStateStore.

questions.question: Which of the following command runs ResourceManager admin client?
questions.explanation: proxyserver command starts the web proxy server.
